Kennedy Junior High School 2025 Illinois Mathcounts[edit]

Kennedy Junior High School in Illinois competed in the 2025 Mathcounts Competition, winning first in Chapter and second in State. One person from the team, William Wu, qualified for Nationals by placing first in the State competition.

Chapter Performance[edit]

Kennedy Mathcounts won first place in its chapter at Dukane Chapter Competition, in the Dukane Chapter.

State Performance[edit]

Kennedy Mathcounts won second place in state at the Illinois State Competition, falling behind the first place winner, Daniel Wright. Further revelations showed the performance in the team round contributed. However, one of Kennedy's students, William Wu, managed to win State individual number one. Kennedy's coach, Haihui Niu, also went on to coach the Illinois National Team.

State Team Members[edit]

The qualifiers that represented Kennedy's team consisted of:

  1. Hannah Che (16)
  2. Philip Du (18)
  3. William Wu (1)
  4. Stanley Yang (44)

Their score at state is also labeled, if known.

Team Culture[edit]

The team for 2025 was orz, and helped spread communism throughout Kennedy.

Kennedy Junior High School 2026 Illinois Mathcounts[edit]

Kennedy Junior High School in Illinois competed in the 2026 Mathcounts Competition, winning first in Chapter and first in State. Two people from the team, William Wu and Jacob Chua, also qualified for Nationals by placing first and third in the State competition, respectively. The occasion marked the first time since 2019 Kennedy won the state championship.

Chapter Performance[edit]

Kennedy Mathcounts won first place in its chapter at Dukane Chapter Competition, in the Dukane Chapter. William Wu earned 1st place, while Jacob Chua earned 3rd place.

State Performance[edit]

Kennedy Mathcounts won first place in state at the Illinois State Competition. Two of Kennedy's students, William Wu and Jacob Chua further managed to make the Illinois National Team. William Wu earned 1st place, and Jacob Chua earned 3rd place. Kennedy's coach, Haihui Niu, also went on to coach the Illinois National Team.

State Team Members[edit]

The qualifiers that represented Kennedy's team consisted of:

  1. Jacob Chua (3)
  2. Ruibin Wang (31)
  3. William Wu (1)
  4. Stanley Yang (21)

Their score at state is also labeled, if known.

Team Culture[edit]

The Kennedy team in 2026 was orz. The group was not communist, but words from the party left it ambiguous the true ideology of the group.
